Sybil resistance here uses staked identity bonds: each agent locks a marble of collateral before voting, and the protocol raises required stake with every new identity. Attacker spend grows faster than influence, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
